reviews.text:
I've had two amazing kitty angels over the past 3 years. Jo and this year Eva (Solihull) both really kind, caring women who went above and beyond to ensure our cat Juni felt at ease and was thoroughly spoiled.
Will continue to book for every holiday

Excellent experience with kitty angels my cats and parrot have loved all the girls that have looked after them Excellent to have dailey updates and photos and videos couldn't ask for better care they take time to play with them and give them lots of love and care ❤️ would definitely highly recommend them will definitely be using them again Thank you to all the angels
The first time we have used Kitty Angels Halesowen for our two male cats, Binx and Salem and it wont the last....Clare looked after our boys and she is amazing....Great job done, highly recommend..

So pleased with the service provided by Kitty Angels. We had daily updates which eased my mind that the pets were ok. They all seemed very happy when we returned home and everything was very clean and tidy. Communication is excellent and they left a lovely touch of a little gift for our return. Will definitely use again and would happily recommend .

Absolutely brilliant service looking after my three cats. They all loved her, and I felt completely reassured while I was away knowing they were so well cared for.

Every day she sent loads of lovely photos along with really funny little commentaries about what the cats had been up to, which I looked forward to receiving. It was such a nice personal touch and made being away from them much easier.

She clearly got to know all three of their different personalities, and I think they genuinely miss her now! I wouldn’t hesitate to use her again and would highly recommend her to anyone looking for someone kind, reliable and genuinely caring to look after their cats.

We were really happy with Kitty Angels. They were so reliable, responsive and well organised, and the detailed daily updates were really reassuring while we were away. It was lovely to know our cats were in such kind and responsible hands, and we felt completely confident that they were being well looked after. We’d definitely use them again.

Kitty Angels Stourbridge - exceptional service from Emma.  Emma has been an absolute star totally trustworthy and reliable. Clearly has a deep love for cats which is shown in her kindness and attentiveness towards all three of our cats. She managed each one of their needs with such love and care I’m not sure they even noticed we had gone!! Emma is a credit to the Angels - she went over and above to look after our home and cats and it has reassured us no end about using and recommending Kitty Angels in the future

We've used Kitty Angels twice now and can't fault them.  Laura is wonderful with our two cats and special consideration was made with regards to our elderly cat who needs medication and I was particularly worried about leaving.  We get wonderful updates and photos after each visit and it makes us feel reassured and safe that the cats are being looked after.

Jenny came to look after our cat for the first time whilst we had a short holiday and was wonderful. She looked after her so well and spent time playing with her and cuddling, as well as all the important bits like feeding, changing litter and making sure she had clean water every day. It was such a bonus that she also kept my plants alive by watering them in hot weather, closing and opening curtains and even putting out the bins.  We wouldn’t know what to do if we didn’t have kitty angels. Now, we have peace of a mind if we book another holiday.

We've used Kitty Angels Birmingham several times to look after our elderly cat while we travel. It's a great service - communication is excellent, with updates and photos at every visit, and the whole process is extremely smooth. Highly recommended.

I’ve using Kitty Angels for a while - they do a fantastic job of looking after my cat while I’m away, including administering meds and coaxing her to eat on her fussy days, as well as providing her with fuss & cuddles on demand!
It gives me great peace of mind to know that she is in safe hands, and I would highly recommend Kitty Angels to any cat owner needing a pet sitting service.

Great service, professional and responsible. Our Peeps was a tricky customer, really anxious as it was her first time with a pet sitter and having some medical troubles with her anxiety. Ellie made every effort to make her comfortable and kept us updated every step of the way. She even phoned the vet for us as we didn't have phone signal. She handled a tough situation admirably.

I recently used Kitty Angels for the first time and am absolutely delighted with the quality of this service.My 2 mature boys were relaxed and chilled,their individual needs and personalities catered for and I had updates and pictures after each visit.Post collected,plants watered,lights turned on and feeding and litter areas immaculate.Run by dedicated cat lovers.Highly recommend! Kate Sth Birmingham

Rachel and the team at Kitty Angels really were absolute angels for my whole family during an incredibly difficult time.

My aunt very sadly passed away following a period in hospital. Her admission had been unexpected, which meant her beloved house cat was suddenly home alone.

From hospital, my aunt sent an SOS email to Kitty Angels asking if they could help. They responded on the very same day they received it, which was particularly important given the heatwave we were experiencing. They immediately made sure her cat was safe and cared for, brought in my aunt’s post and bought provisions for her cat when needed.

As part of their service, Kitty Angels also sent my aunt a daily message updating her on how her pet was doing. While this may be a standard part of what they do, they gave my aunt reassurance that her much-loved cat was safe and being cared for, and for that we are enormously grateful.

After my aunt died, Rachel continued to work with me and other members of our family as we tried to navigate a very difficult situation. The cat had always had a rather challenging, but understandably this became considerably worse with the enormous amount of change happening around her. Rachel offered many helpful suggestions, remained in contact with us and did everything she could to help us manage the situation safely.

Our family eventually arranged for the rescue the cat had originally come from to take her back into their care. While we worked through those arrangements, and when family members couldn’t be in the area, the Kitty Angels team continued visiting and caring for her. Knowing that she was being looked after gave us one less thing to worry about at a time when there was already an overwhelming amount to deal with.

Throughout all of this, Kitty Angels treated my aunt’s home and belongings with complete respect and maintained her privacy. Her house was unattended by anyone other than their team for more than two weeks, and I can attest completely to their trustworthiness, integrity and kindness.

I’m also fairly certain that somewhere along the way, a Kitty Angel quietly dealt with the food that inevitably spoiled in the fridge, simply so that we wouldn’t have to face it.

That perhaps sums them up better than anything.

Rachel was kind when kindness really mattered. She and her team went above and beyond in every way imaginable. They took care of an animal who needed them, gave reassurance to my aunt while she was in hospital and continued supporting our family after she died.

Thank you simply doesn’t feel like a big enough word for what Rachel and the Kitty Angels team did for us during one of the most difficult periods our family has experienced.

We will never forget it.

Kitty Angels Steph, Debbie and Aiden have done a wonderful job in looking after my tuxedo cat, Freddie, for 2 months, while I was in hospital and convalescing. They really looked after him, as he has been poorly and so they had to give him his meds twice daily. This included BP and B12 pills, and saline injections. as well as Pronefra fluid and mirataz cream for his ears, to help his appetite. They also had to take him to the vet too as he had a seizure. And they picked up meds as they ran out So it really was a very big job. I can't thank them enough. But, what's more, I can't thank them enough for also making a real fuss of him; and for playing catch the fish with him. He's a real charmer; he was at the door when they arrived! And he posed for the many photos and videos they sent me to reassure me that he was ok and for the twice daily reports on him. Indeed, they showed he looked very bonny which I also found when I got home. I must say, he looked at me with disdain then, and was 'saying' who are you? and where have you been? and you are not my Kitty Angel ! He does miss you. I highly recommend Kitty Angels; they are just that. Thank you. Gill Xx

They've looked after our cat over the last 2-3 years when we've been away and we always know he is in safe, caring and loving hands. The regular updates are really reassuring when we're away, and always make us smile. Thanks so much xx

Absolute easiest 5 stars I've ever given! Incredible service, I've had a couple of folks here look after my cat while I've been away and the peace of mind is incredibly worth it! Constant photos and updates from people who genuinely care about your cats! Cannot recommend enough!

Kitty Angels are absolutely brilliant! We contracted them to look after our Darwin for a week, having never left him on his own before. They came for a pre-trip visit to meet him, then a couple of times each day whilst we were away. Each time they send a detailed message of how Darwin was doing, along with pictures & videos, and spent time playing & cuddling with him. Their attention & dedication did wonders to reduce our anxiety and kept Darwin happy while we were gone. We recommend these fine folks without hesitation & will definitely be using their services again.

Been using Kitty Angels for years and they never miss a beat. Absolutely outstanding service everytime and the updates that we get via whatsapp are top notch. Every visit you receive pictures and videos from your kitty angel and detailed messages.

Highly recommend to anybody who is going away and doesnt want their cats to be taken away from their home.

Jen takes excellent care of my cat while I am away! I get updates following every visit and she takes the time to fuss and play with my cat as well as feed him and make sure his water is always clean. She’s very thoughtful and caring and I feel so much better when I know she’s watching my cat while I’m away. Thank you Jen!

Kitty Angels took such great care of our cat Max while we were away for a few weeks on our honeymoon. The daily updates were great and really thorough, and reassured us that he was in the best hands! Every day we got loads of photos of him as well, and we could tell from the pictures how much Max enjoyed all the new friends he was making! We will definitely use Kitty Angels again the next time we go away.

I went away for a week and was so worried about leaving my three cats but I've got to say that Wendy looked after them so well .
Twice a day I received pictures, videos and a quick report on how everyone was doing, I've come back to very happy cats and the only downside is that I think they are disappointed that I don't seem to play as well or give them enough treats 😂 wish I could give them 6 stars !

Jeanette was amazing with our 3 girls. From the pictures she sent we could tell how amazing they were being treated and how much she cared for them and loved looking after them, we have come back to happy chilled out cats and could not be more grateful to Jeanette for all she did for us! Amazing service, would 100% recommend to anyone who needs their cats looking after.

Fantastic service led by Jenny and her team of sitters.  Ali was a star taking care of our 2 cats while away for a long weekend.  We received updates and photos for each visit and had genuine peace of mind that our home and pets were being well cared for.  Highly recommend!

We have recently entrusted our beautiful soft DEAF cat to Laura from Kittyangels in Stourbridge. What can I say, they have had the most wonderful time together. Mila, who is a softy,  turned out to be a clever little thief helping  herself to food pouches. Laura sent the most amazing videos which amused us all on the horrible wet rainy days in wales. Mila was obviously extremely happy and we would always recommend Kittyangels to everyone

Lovely, reliable and friendly service. Bridget kept us updated with daily pictures and a detailed summary of how he was doing and the games they were playing together. This was the first time we have left him since he was a kitten so we were apprehensive but Kitty Angels took our worries away and treated our cat like he was there own.

This really is an amazing company!  The staff are so warm and kind,  our furbabies loved them all.  We have used them a few times now and everytime its the same excellent caring service that provides daily photos of your kitties as well which is a really nice touch.  We would not use anyone else!
What an amazing service Vikki looked after our boys so well and made us feel so reassured about our precious babies. We cant thank her enough. Xx

Thank you for looking after our two cats and loving them while we’ve been away.  It’s a great piece of mind knowing they are staying home rather than boarding.

One of our cats struggles so much in a cattery and then when we  get him back home he see’s us as super evil people and hides for ages.

It's a great weight off our minds knowing that they can stay home and still get loved when we go away.  You are always going to be our go to for anytime in the future!

Great. Lovely and friendly, lots of communication and pics of our cat when we are away. Since family moved further away we were nervous about leaving our cat with strangers but they are really good with her (and us!)

Rachel and Lily were brilliant. Gave us daily updates, lots of photos and peace of mind that our cat was well looked after. Can tell that they genuinely love cats and their jobs. Would highly recommend!

Couldn't recommend more highly for really great care of your cats, and excellent communication whilst you are away. My cats love everyone who has looked after them (and they aren't usually the friendliest!) and I can feel completely confident that they are being looked after perfectly. I'm convinced all cats hate a cattery, and this is the perfect solution for mine!

We have used Kitty Angels twice now for our 2 cats and we are beyond impressed
We highly recommend them.

I’ve now had Liz from the Central Birmingham Kitty Angels team look after my two cats several times, and I couldn’t be happier with the service. The customer care is incredible; far better than anything I’ve had before, and genuinely more affordable than other options like Rover.com.

Liz is extremely professional and reassuring. During our first meeting, she came with a carefully planned list of questions about my cats, which instantly showed how thorough and prepared she was. It was very reassuring, and she also took the time to answer all of my questions. Every visit comes with plenty of photos and a detailed report, which I really appreciate.

One of the best parts about Kitty Angels is the consistency; you get the same person (or someone from the same small team), so they really get to know your pets and their routines.

I highly recommend Kitty Angels, and especially Liz. I always feel completely at ease knowing my cats are being well looked after.

10/10 service. Kitty Angels cared brilliantly for my cat. They were organised, caring, and capable, making my trip away stress-free, sending brilliant updates, and communicating clearly and promptly from booking to billing.

Could not have asked for a better service! Got great updates daily from our cat sitter Jos who was amazing. Our 2 cats were played with daily and looked after perfectly! Amazing service and a lovely team of people. Would definitely recommend!

My go-to cat sitter in Birmingham, I have been using them for over a year now. Bridget from the Central Brum team specifically takes care of my cats whenever I am away and always does a fantastic job! Thanks to her one of my shy cats has actually gotten braver around strangers generally.

I highly recommend them if you want peace of mind when leaving your pets behind - they always send you updates, plenty of photos and kind messages. Highly highly recommend and I can safely say they are the most professional and nice cat sitters in Birmingham!

Used the kitty angels again, for my new little fur ball and I have to say they were fantastic.
I went away for a week and this was the first time I’d left her, so I was anxious.
The communication, little updates and pictures/videos are always fab and she was so calm and settled when I got home. Booked in my next trip knowing she’s in safe hands. I can’t recommended this team enough! Thankyou
These Guys are are the best, Always do a brilliant job I can't fault them.
Great service, so nice to know your cat is being looked after whilst away and the cute messages and photos are lovely! Highly recommended.

Fantastic cat sitting service. I've been using kitty angels for a number of years and the service is always excellent. Easy to book, clear communication and confirmation. Updates after every visit with photos/videos. Our cats are super happy with kitty angels and they definitely prefer the visiting cat toys to the ones we have at home! I would highly recommend.
Kitty Angels have taken all the stress out of leaving our cat when we go away. Great service and communication and we know our cat is going to be cared for, with all her specific needs met.

Huge thanks to Jenny for looking after Max whist I was on holiday! I loved the daily updates and photos! It was very comforting to know he was being well looked after whilst I was away. Highly recommend the service and I have booked again for my next trip.

Love Kitty’s Angels! They look after my cat and chickens and nothing is too much trouble. Love the photos and videos they send me. Would definitely recommend. Have been using them for years now and know my animals will be well cared for whilst we’re away.
Always reliable and care for my cats very well. Detailed updates when I'm away which put my mind at rest.

What a fantastic service, I cannot recommend this service enough. My cats are soo well looked after, and suffer no disturbance to their normal routine whenI go away.  The girls go above and beyond to not only support the safety and welfare of my cats but my home also
Thank you and thank god for your company
The best cat sitters around.  It’s clear how much they care about each cat they look after. The daily updates and photos are a real bonus.

Godsend for when we're away - great, friendly team and love that our cats are well looked after and loved when we're not there. Always get fab (and hilarious) update pics and videos to let us know our ferries are doing ok!

Liz (Kitty Angels Central Birmingham) was great with my timid cat while we were away. She sent us daily, detailed updates with photos, and spent the time to make her feel comfortable.

Would highly recommend

We recently used Kitty Angels (Central Birmingham) for the first time, to catsit while we were on holiday. The service was very professional and personable, and we appreciated the regular updates and attention to detail. We would be happy to use the service again and to recommend it.
Excellent service my cat is well looked after and the regular updates are reassuring Thank you
Excellent service and lovely people. Very reassuring to know that our cats are being well cared for while we're away.
I have used Kitty Angels for years and they've always provided an amazing service. Paige is wonderful, she even manages to charm my extremely shy cat! Couldn't recommend highly enough!

we have just back home from our holidays and our cat Arthur was taken care of by Liz. We found Arthur very calm, happy, very relaxed, really happy of his days with Liz. At each visit Liz sent us photos and updates on our cat. She followed all our instructions making our holidays more peaceful. she was so sweet to leave us some milk and bread, and she left some treats for Arthur, his favourites. It was our first time with Kitty Angels and it will be our choice every time we go on holiday. Liz is really sweet, attentive and available. And we are happy that Arthur really enjoyed her company.

We have been using Kitty Angels since 2017 and cannot fault their service. The peace of mind it gives us to have our three cats and one bunny looked after by a group of caring animal lovers is priceless. Over the years they have taken one of our cats to the vets when they fell ill when we are away, have looked after our plants, have put out and brought in our bins and even dealt with locksmith issues. They really do go above and beyond. We know our beloved pets are in very safe hands with Kitty Angels and the WhatsApp updates and pictures are worth everything. Highly recommend.
Great service, always feel comfortable going away knowing the furry fellas will be in good hands!

We're so fortunate having Kitty Angels to look after Smokey when we are away. It is really reassuring to know our best friend is in good hands and most special care. We love the pictures, videos and stories we get from Zak every day, also Jason's and Tony's attention to all admin tasks. You deserve more than 5 stars! Thank you Kitty Angels!

Kitty Angels were wonderful looking after my cats while I went away. They updated me daily and sent photos. Cats weren’t sulking when I got home and were happy. It was a huge weight off my mind to know they were being so well looked after and played with every day.

Just amazing service, my cats love it when we go away and Kitty angels home in. Caring responsive service very reasonably priced. It’s lovely to receive photos of cats while we are away. From the bottom of my heart thank you for excellent service

I am extremely happy with the services provided by Kitty Angels. Elizabeth took care of my cat Puma for a week, and I couldn’t be more satisfied with the experience. Every day, she sent me updates and photos of Puma, letting me know that he was doing well, which gave me great peace of mind. I have used Kitty Angels’ services in the past, and every time, I’ve been impressed with their care and professionalism. I will definitely continue to trust them with the care of my pets in the future. Highly recommended!

I have been using the wonderful Kitty Angels for many years now and I am always very happy that my cats would be taken very good care of while I'm away. They all clearly love cats and provide a professional and personal service. Both me and my cat Phoenix are very happy!
Very friendly and professional team. I get daily updates on how my cat is doing and never worry about her when I’m away. Purrfect!

Kitty Angels are the best.
I foster cats and also.have quite a few of my own. If it wasn't for kitty Angels we couldn't go away. They look after every single need of my cats! Including a naughty Bengal who likes to escape and sits in the fridge to eat ' her' chicken.
You really are amazing.

Kitty Angels have cared for my cat a few times now and always provide an excellent service - they update with pictures/videos and a lovely text explaining everything they've done, it really does set my mind at rest.
I would definitely recommend using them to care for your cat whilst you're away from home!

I can only praise the service I received from kitty Angels and Bridget who looked after my 2 cats whilst I was away. I got photos following every visit and an update of how the cats were. I came home to 2 very happy and chilled our cats, I already have a few bookings made for the next few months

Kitty angels are a wonderful pet sitting service. They have great levels of communication before and after visits. They put my mind at rest sending photos and updates. Thankfully they also take care of my ducks for me when needed. My pets always look comfortable and happy around the kitty angels that visit. I would highly recommend them.

We have 2 house cats who we'd tried leaving with a cattery in the past. They were very unhappy and anxious in an unfamiliar setting, and one of them even stopped eating! Cue Kitty Angels to come to the rescue!! Our beloved cats ars well cared for in the comfort and familiarity of their own home. Each visit includes playtime and enrichment activities. Best of all is that we get daily pics and videos, so we can see just how happy and relaxed our pets are. Highly recommend using Kitty Angels

We have been using Kitty Angels for many years for various cats. We are always impressed with the care the Angels give  - not just feeding but playing and spending time for fuss and cuddles. They give updates for every visit and the photos are lovely and you can see that your precious pet is safe and happy. Full marks - we wouldn’t use anyone else.

We could not recommend Kitty Angels enough if we tried!

A fantastic service for those that struggle leaving their fur babies when going away - Kitty Angels give brilliant in-depth updates along with lots of lovely pictures. Each update is like a little story about how your little ones have been getting on and they’re a pleasure to read. The angels really take pride in what they do and looking after your babies!

Ellie first spoke to me via a phone call and really reassured me on how the process works - this was my first time leaving my girls and I’ve since had many successful visits and I can enjoy my trips knows my girls are being well looked after.

A special shout out to Debbie and Steph, our girls LOVE their visits and even manage to gets purrs and cuddles! 🥰

If you’re going away and need your babies to be looked after - the angels are the way to go! X

I have been using Kitty Angels for a number of years now.  They are absolutely wonderful.  Completely reliable and flexible.  All the Angels really care about my cats.  I cant recommend them highly enough!!
I use these cat sitters regularly and could not recommend them more highly. They have always taken excellent care of my pets and keep me up to date when I am away.

I can’t speak highly enough of the Kitty Angels Birmingham team. Following an initial phone consultation (where they discussed our cat’s requirements and other aspects, such as our home security and key arrangements), they now regularly take excellent care of our 18 year old cat who also has minor medical needs. Not only are they respectful of our property, we receive friendly updates and pics of our cat after each of their visits - which are always reassuring whilst we are away. With prior arrangement, they will also open/close curtains, water plants and put out your bins should you wish them to.

It’s a big thing to let strangers into your home when you aren’t there, but I can whole heartedly recommend Ellie and her team - they have always been highly professional and trustworthy and genuinely care about our cat.

We have been using the amazing Kitty Angels for a couple of years now for visits to our elderly house cat.
Right from the start I was really impressed, we had out initial call with Ellie to tell her all about our cat, the level of detail that Ellie wanted to know and her love for cats shone through and we knew our cat would be in safe hands.
Ellie sets up a whatsapp group so after each visit, we get what my partner refers to as 'the report card' which advises us of what the Angel got up to on their visit and how our cat was.
Our little old lady takes a while to trust and its been wonderful to see her walls coming down especially with her favourite Angel Steph and the genuine happiness from the whole team that Steph got a proper cuddle.
I would totally reccomend Kitty Angels to anyone.

Kitty Angels were fab looking after my 9 cats whilst I was on holiday.  I appreciated the daily updates, photos and assurances all was fine.  They also looked after my cats previously inc. administering medication and insulin injections to my diabetic cat which meant we could relax knowing our cat was in capable hands.  I will definitely continue to use their services in the future.
Top-notch kitty cat care from attentive, kind & thoughtful Angels. We always come home to happy cats. Thank you 😻😻 …

Such a great service and team! They always keep us updated with regular messages and photos, which is so reassuring, and they look after our furry boys with such care and attention. It’s clear they genuinely love what they do, and it shows in how happy and relaxed our pets are when we return. Highly recommend! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I cant recommend KItty Angels highly enough - they are great value but even more importantly, sincerely care about the work they do. The regular updates form the sitters is always wonderful to receive and will always go the extra mile to keep the furries happy!

Used Kitty Angels many times for my last cat and current two. They have always been reliable and caring, and are cats are much happier staying at home when we are away. Communication is excellent. Highly recommended.

Highly recommend Kitty Angels - we have used them several times over the last few years and they always provide an impeccable service, and make sure our cats are well looked after. It definitely puts our minds at rest when we’re away that they are being looked after by such lovely people! Thank you!
Eva Worsell

Honestly couldn’t be more grateful for Kitty Angels, they make going away and leaving our two boys easier, we love the photos we get while we are away and find ourselves waiting for them as the only part of going on holiday we hate is leaving them.
They had a very lengthy phone call before the first visit discussing everything about our boys from food to toilet habits, dos and donts even including their nicknames and we have just used them for the second time this year, they make things so stress free when going away and leaving our babies. Thanks Kitty Angels!

Really lovely team who genuinely care so much about your cat.
They send detailed updates and photos, and follow instructions to the letter. Helpful, flexible customer service.

Kitty Angels recently looked after our two 8 month old kittens. We adopted them in August and didn’t want to uproot them while we were away. From the moment we contacted Kitty Angels, I knew we’d done the right thing.  Communication with all members of the team was excellent, and we knew we had left the Boys in safe hands. We loved having photos and updates each day, and in addition we had the reassurance that an eye was being kept on the house - curtains opened and closed, radio on and off, bins put out etc. We came home to two very relaxed cats who had obviously loved all the attention they’d received while we were away. I would not hesitate to recommend Kitty Angels, and we will definitely use them again.

We have been using Kitty Angels for several years now and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend. Our cat has been so much happier whilst we’ve been away with the wonderful care and attention Kitty Angels has provided. Thanks Jason and Tony and the Kitty Angels team!

Kitty Angels have looked after my cat, Bob, several times, varying from a couple of days to over 2 weeks. They have been fantastic every time and Bob has been very happy every time we have returned. We have had a lot of building work and …
I have used Kitty Angels ever since they began. It’s a great company. My cats are always well looked after and are very relaxed when I get home. I love the photos.
100% best service - caring and efficient - my furry babies love them too !!

My kitties love kitty angels 😇 I swear they have a better time with them than me . Kitty angels are litterally angels, they not only feed my kitties and scoop the litter they play with them and send me updates and pictures on every visits. …
